title: Plant-based Sausage Egg McMuffin recreation and blind taste test with an ex-McDonalds employee
summary: In this Goodful video, host May attempts a vegan recreation of the Sausage Egg McMuffin using supermarket plant-based items and kitchen improvisation. She experiments with two vegan sausages (Impossible and Light Life), tofu-based egg white and a yolk made from Just Egg, and two vegan cheese options, all baked or heated with Miyoko’s butter. A steel egg ring is used to shape patties, and flavors are built with maple syrup, sage, salt, pepper, and kala namak (black salt) to mimic eggy notes. May and her guest Nini, a former McDonald’s employee and manager, taste both the vegan version and a store-bought McMuffin in a side-by-side test to see if the vegan version can fool a former McDonald’s worker. The video documents the iterative testing of textures and meltiness, the assembly sequence (toasted muffins with cheese on the bottom, sausages, egg substitute, and top muffin), and a final verdict that the vegan version can be surprisingly convincing, leaving even a carnivore-reared tester impressed.
